steps.content: [Change Fraser's corridor to green]
There is no end in sight, and the way back has vanished. You are walking through what feels like a long dark casket.
Phantoms stream past you, and their lament echoes from wall to wall, a chorus of quiet, endless weeping.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>A place to rest... a place to rest...!

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Give me a place to rest...!
Shrieks of terror flood in from the darkness behind, only to be caught in the cramped stone chamber, ricocheting endlessly off the walls.
Lichen gazes at the pillar in front of her. Its crown has been shattered, and a web of hairline fractures snakes down its length. Still, the pale cyan light radiating from the stone intensifies.
Chunks of debris tumble down and strike the ground at her feet. She doesn't even flinch.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Heh.
She lifts her hand and swirls her fingers through the air. The drifting cyan phantoms hesitate, just for a heartbeat, then rush inward, gathering fast at the center.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Aaaaaaaah!

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Aaaaaaaah!
Whoosh!

A paper talisman slices through the air and slaps onto a phantom's head, burning it to ash in a heartbeat. A second one follows right behind, flying toward the rift and cutting off the phantoms streaming out.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Even when none of this concerns you... even when you already know how it ends for us...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You still cannot bring yourself to do nothing...
...Bang!
The paper talisman gives out, fluttering wildly before it detonates and blasts the leading phantoms apart. But the reprieve is brief; more of them come clawing through the rift, a relentless flood.
Chengxiao staggers backward. His arm, caught in the explosion, is already darkening.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Xiansheng... is your hand alright?

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Xiansheng? Xiansheng?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Lyu Buzhou?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So, what does the divination say?
Her voice carried a smile as she plucked needles from the potted pine on his windowsill. The Daoist texts said the pine was resilient, weathering frost and snow, evergreen and unfading.
She drifted closer and studied the hexagrams on the table with a show of keen interest. In truth, she didn't care at all what they foretold.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Whatever the hexagrams say, you intend to go regardless. Am I wrong?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Hmm... <color=#fb9259>"Flames dye the heavens, and the divine draws near; the spirit is slowly steeped, until the divine dwells within; the dragon soars too high and learns regret, and what descends into darkness shall not return."</color>...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And someone looked at that and called it a terribly ill omen?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: For those of us who seek the Dao, a glimpse behind the curtain of heaven is about the best thing you could hope for in one lifetime.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Then perhaps you ought to have cast the divination yourself. Though I confess some doubt as to whether you still recall the method.
Lichen shook her head, still smiling, and pressed her palm against the coarse paper. Pine needles slipped from between her fingers and scattered across the surface.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And what would be the point? The heavens and I have never seen eye to eye on much.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Heh. Let the others hear you speak that way, and they shall have fresh cause to label you a heretic.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: "Baleful star," "wretched"... Trust me, I've been called worse.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You know what I really can't stand, though? Sitting around doing nothing. Letting my backside gather moss up on that mountain.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So? Have you decided yet?

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: ...Xiansheng?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...So that is how it is...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The spirit is slowly steeped, until the divine dwells within</color>...
He had meant to follow, partly to keep a watch on Li Xianling. That girl put too much faith in the unorthodox and would walk herself right into the fate the hexagrams had laid out. As for himself...
He once believed that clinging to the rules and reasoning through each step would eventually reveal a way out.
But when had the rules started to trap him instead? The more he struggled to see clearly, the tighter they bound him, barring him from taking a single step forward.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Heh. It seems I, too, have wandered too far.
From the moment he stepped into that ocean of lanterns, the <color=#fb9259>voice</color> had been guiding him, patient and insistent, telling him to set things right and push no further.
It demanded he face the "truth," yet prevented him from chasing it?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You guided us here. You have already written the ending for us. Why go to the trouble of this charade? Unless you fear what else we might uncover.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: It would seem the divine is not so very divine after all.

Chengxiao casts a glance around. Keylan is still at it behind him, jabbing at the receiver in his hands, straining to catch a signal from camp. The device spits back nothing but static and error tones.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Step back a little.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I would like to see for myself—

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Exactly what our esteemed "god" is so worried about.
He pulls in a long breath and murmurs an incantation under his breath. The markings on his arm darken, and through the mist, ghostly flames flicker to life.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Above and below, in all realms of the dead...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...no fiend shall disobey this command!
[Chengxiao's corrupted character art]
In front of the ruined tunnel entrance, the shadow wavers briefly, then thickens into something more solid. Then, he steps forward.
